# Installation

## Preliminaries

- Install `pak` (if you haven’t already): `install.packages("pak")`

You might also need to install Rtools
(<https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/>) if the installation
step below does not work correctly.

## For initial installation or updates

- Install MuscleTernary from github:
  `pak::pak("Middleton-Lab/MuscleTernary")`

View
[`?MuscleTernary`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/MuscleTernary-package.md)
or `demo(ternary_plot)` for a demo.

# Package index

## Working with stl meshes

### Reading meshes and working with centroids

Functions to import meshes and calculate centroids and sizes (areas)

- [`read_stl()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/read_stl.md)
  : Import STL mesh
- [`centroid_location()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/centroid_location.md)
  : Calculate centroid location
- [`centroid_size()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/centroid_size.md)
  : Calculate centroid size for an stl file
- [`stl_area()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/stl_area.md)
  : Calculate area of an stl mesh

### PCSA and muscle force estimation

Functions for estimating PCSA and muscle architecture from centroid data
and muscle force from PCSA estimates

- [`muscle_force()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/Muscle_Force.md)
  : Estimate muscle force
- [`pennation_angle()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/pennation_angle.md)
  : Find pennation angle
- [`pcsa()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/PCSA.md)
  : Estimate PCSA from from a pair of muscle attachment stl meshes.

## Making ternary plots

Functions used to generate ternary plots

- [`coords_to_ternary()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/coords_to_ternary.md)
  : Process coordinates data.frame
- [`interpolate_ternary()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/interpolate_ternary.md)
  : Interpolate between two point in a coordinates object.
- [`muscle_color_map()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/muscle_color_map.md)
  : Holliday Lab Muscle Color Map
- [`muscle_fill_map()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/muscle_fill_map.md)
  : Holliday Lab Muscle Color Map
- [`means_by_muscle()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/means_by_muscle.md)
  : Means by Muscle

## Working with Xfiber data

Functions to read and process data from Avizo Xfiber suitable for
passing as the `coords` parameter to
[`coords_to_ternary()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/coords_to_ternary.md)

- [`read_xfiber()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/read_xfiber.md)
  : Import from Avizo xfiber Excel
- [`read_xfiber_xml()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/read_xfiber_xml.md)
  : Import from Avizo xfiber XML
- [`ends_to_vectors()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/ends_to_vectors.md)
  : Function turning xfiber endpoint vectors into unit vectors Should be
  used following 'find_track_ends'
- [`find_track_ends()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/find_track_ends.md)
  : Reduce Xfiber tracks to vectors connecting the two endpoints
- [`central_axis()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/central_axis.md)
  : Define muscle force axis vector

## Generating Maya mel scripts

Functions for outputting mel scripts to create model + vector arrows in
Maya.

- [`make_mel()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/make_mel.md)
  : Write mel file
- [`xfiber_to_maya()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/xfiber_to_maya.md)
  : Generate Maya mel file from xfiber tracing
- [`geom_shiftedtext()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/geom_shiftedtext.md)
  : geom for labeling geom_points

## Utility functions

Functions that are not normally called directly, but which may be useful
and are thus documented and exported.

- [`xprod()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/xprod.md)
  : Cross-product of two 3d vectors
- [`make_unit_vector()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/make_unit_vector.md)
  : Create a unit vector from a given vector
- [`relative_proportion()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/relative_proportion.md)
  : Calculate the relative proportion of the items of a given vector
- [`write_arrows()`](https://middleton-lab.github.io/MuscleTernary/reference/write_arrows.md)
  : Write Maya arrows code
